network_enforcement: Every Lean subprocess runs under bubblewrap with an unshared network, a read-only host root, fixed environment variables, and one fresh temporary directory as its only writable bind. The outer Python reconciler performs local file, hash, process, and Git checks only.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line reconciliation summary bound in release-receipt.json

scope_boundary: This bounded worker recipe authenticates current inputs, replays the exact statement and four partial bodies at trust zero, and checks a negative release decision. It reuses pinned warm artifacts and cannot accept the validation dependency, close any frozen obligation or the exact root, supply H0/R0 or complete trust/provenance evidence, perform a cold offline release build, act as an independent verifier, or grant release/master acceptance.
